G0301G.def:
Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, Is 1:1; עָמוֹס, Am 1:1; אָמוֹן, 4Ki.21:18 ff. B)
__1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: Mt 1:10.
__2. Amos: Lc 3:25.†
(AS)

G0301H.def:
Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, Is 1:1; עָמוֹס, Am 1:1; אָמוֹן, 4Ki.21:18 ff. B)
__1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: Mt 1:10.
__2. Amos: Lc 3:25.†
(AS)

G0302.def:
ἄν,
conditional particle,
which cannot usually be separately translated in English, its force depending on the constructions which contain it (see further, LS, see word; WM, §xlii; M, Pr., 165 ff.; MM, VGT, see word).
__1. In apodosis,
__(i) with indic, imperfect or aor., expressing what would be or would have been if (εἰ with impf., aor. or plpf.) some condition were or had been fulfilled: Lc 7:39 17:6, Jo 5:46, Gl 1:10, Mt 12:7 24:43, 1Co 2:8, At 18:14, 1Jo 2:19, al. The protasis is sometimes understood (as also in cl.): Mt 25:27, Lc 19:23. In hypothetical sentences, expressing unreality, ἄν (as often in late writers, more rarely in cl.) is omitted: Jo 8:39 15:24 19:11, Rm 7:7, Gl 4:15;
__(ii) with opt., inf., ptcp. (cl.; see LS, see word; M, Int., §275; M, Pr., 167:4).
__2. In combination with conditional, relative, temporal, and final words;
__(i) as in cl., with subj.,
__(a) in protasis with εἰ, in Attic contr. ἐάν, which see;
__(b) in conditional, relative, and temporal clauses (coalescing with ὅτε, ἐπεί, etc.; see: ὅταν, ἐπάν, etc.), ever, soever;
__(α) with pres., ἡνίκα, 2Co 3:15; ὃς ἄν, Rm 9:15 (LXX) 16:2, al.; ὅσοι ἄν, Lc 9:5; ὡς ἄν, Rm 15:24 (M, Pr., 167);
__(β) with aor., ὃς ἄν, Mt 5:21, 22, 31; ἕως ἄν, until, Mt 2:13, Mc 6:10, al.; ὡς ἄν, as soon as (M, Pr., 167), 1Co 11:34, Fp 2:23. On the frequently use of ἐάν for ἄν with the foregoing words, see: ἐάν;
__(ii) in late Gk., when some actual fact is spoken of, with indic.: ὅταν (which see); ὅπου ἄν, Mc 6:56 (M, Pr., 168); καθότι ἄν, At 2:45 4:35; ὡς ἄν, 1Co 12:2.
__3. in iterative construction, with imperfect and aor. indic. (M, Pr., 167): At 2:45 4:35, 1Co 12:2.
__4. with optative, giving a potential sense to a question or wish: At 8:31 26:29.
__5. Elliptical constructions: εἰ μή τι ἄν (M, Pr., 169), 1Co 7:5; ὡς ἄν, with inf., as it were (op. cit. 167), 2Co 10:9.
(AS)

G0303.def:
ἀνά
prep. (the rarest in NT; M, Pr., 98; MM, VGT, see word), prop.,
upwards, up, always with accusative
__1. In phrases: ἀ. μέσον, among, between, with genitive, Mt 13:1-58 25:1-46, Mc 7:31, 1Co 6:5 (M, Pr., 99), Ap 7:17 [so in LXX for בְּתוׄך׃]; ἀ. μέρος, in turn, 1Co 14:27 (both found in Polyb.; cf. MGr. ἀνάμεσα).
__2. Distrib., apiece, by: Mt 20:9-10, Lc 9:3 (WH om.), Lc 9:14 Lc 10:1, Jo 2:6, Ap 4:8.
__3. Adverbially ("a vulgarism," B1., § 51, 5; cf. Deiss., BS, 139 f.), ἀ. εἷς ἕκαστος, Ap 21:21.
As prefix, ἀ. signifies
__(a) up: ἀναβαίνειν;
__(b) to: ἀναγγέλλειν;
__(with) anew: ἀναγεννᾶν;
__(d) back: ἀνακάμπτειν.†
(AS)

G0304.def:
ἀνα-βαθμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX for מַעֲלָה: מַעֲלָה: 3Ki.10:19-20, 4Ki.9:13 20:9 ff, 2Cr 9:18-19, Is 38:8, Eze.40:6, 49; ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀ., tit. Sl 120:1-7 121:1-8 122:1-9 123:1-4 124:1-8 125:1-5 126:1-6 127:1-5 128:1-6 129:1-8 130:1-8 131:1-3 132:1-18 133:1-3 134:1-3)* ;]
__1. a going up, an ascent (Pss, ll. with ?).
__2. a step (LXX); p1., a flight of stairs: At 21:35, 40. (On the formation -θμός, see MM, VGT, see word)†
(AS)

G0305.def:
ἀναβαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה ;]
to go up, ascend,
__(a) of persons: ἐπί συκομωρέαν, Lc 19:4; εἰς τ. πλοῖον, Mc 6:51; εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, Mt 20:17; εἰς τ. ἱερόν, with inf. (M, Pr., 205), Lc 18:10; with mention of place of departure, Mt 3:16 (ἀπό), At 8:39 (ἐκ);
__(b) of things, to rise, spring up, come up: a fish, Mt 17:27; smoke, Ap 8:4; plants growing, Mt 13:7; metaphorically, of things coming up in one's mind (as Heb. לֵב אֵל עָלָה; 4Ki.12:4, al.), Lc 24:38, 1Co 2:9; of prayers, At 10:4; messages, At 21:31 (for late exx., see MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)

G0306.def:
ἀνα-βάλλω
[in LXX: Sl 78:21 89:38 (עָבַר), 1Rs 28:14, Sl 104:2 (עָטָה) ;]
to defer, put off (MM, VGT, see word): mid., At 24:22.†
(AS)

G0307.def:
ἀνα-βιβάζω
(causal of ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for רָכַב hi., etc. ;]
to make go up, draw up, as a ship (Xen.): σαγήνην, Mt 13:48 (metaphorically, MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0308.def:
ἀνα-βλέπω
[in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא ;]
__1. to look up: Mc 8:24, al.; before εἰς, Mt 14:19, al. (Xen., Plat.).
__2. to recover sight (Plat., Aristoph.; cf. MM, VGT, see word): Mt 11:5, Jo 9:11, al
(AS)

G0309.def:
ἀνά-βλεψις, -εως, ή
(ἀναβλέπω), [in LXX: Is 61:1 (פְּקַח־קוֹחַ)* ;]
recovery of sight: Lc 4:18 (Lxx).†
(AS)

G0310.def:
ἀνα-βοάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for צָעַק, זָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;]
to cry out: Mt 27:46 (WH, ἐβόησεν; see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0311.def:
ἀναβολή, - ῆς, ἡ
(ά αβάλλω), [in LXX for בּנף, etc. ;]
delay: At 25:17 (for exx. of other meanings, see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0312.def:
ἀν-αγγέλλω
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi ;]
__1. to bring back word, report (Æsch., Thuc., al.): Jo 5:15 (WH, εἶπεν), At 14:27 15:4, 2Co 7:7
__2. Later, = ἀπαγγέλλω (MM, VGT, see word), to announce, declare (LXX; Cremer, 24): Mt 28:11 (WH, ἀπ-), Jo 4:25 16:13-15, At 19:18 20:20, 27 Rm 15:21, 1Pe 1:12, 1Jo 1:5.†
(AS)

G0313.def:
ἀνα-γεννάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sir prol.17 א* (ΑΒאc παρα-)* ;]
to beget again: metaphorically, of spiritual birth, 1Pe 1:3 1:23 (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0314.def:
ἀνα-γινώσκω
(Attic ἀναγιγν-), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
__1. to know certainly, know again, recognize.
__2. Of written characters, to read: Mt 24:15, Mc 13:14, At 15:31 23:34, Ef 3:4; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 22:31, Mc 12:10 Lc 6:3, Jo 19:20, At 8:30, 32, 2Co 1:13, Ap 1:3; with accusative of person(s), Ἠσαίαν τ. προφήτην, At 8:28, 30; before ἐν, Mt 12:5 21:42, Mc 12:26 (so. ἐν τ. νόμῳ), Lc 10:26; before ὅτι, Mt 19:4 21:16; τί ἐποίησε, Mt 12:3, Mc 2:25; pass. 2Co 3:2; of reading aloud (MM, VGT, see word), Lc 4:16, At 13:27 15:21, 2Co 3:15, Cl 4:16, 1Ts 5:27 (M, Th., in l).†
(AS)

G0315.def:
ἀναγκάζω
(ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: Pv 6:7 (שֹׁטֵר), I Et 3:24, 1Ma.2:25, al. ;]
to necessitate, compel by force or persuasion, constrain: with accusative, 2Co 12:11; id. with inf., Mt 14:22, Mc 6:45, Lc 14:23, At 26:11 (on the imperfect here, see Field, Notes, 141; M, Pr., 128 f., 247), Gl 2:14 6:12; pass., C. inf., At 28:19, Gl 2:3 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0316.def:
ἀναγκαῖος, -αῖα, -αῖον
(ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: Et 8:13, Wis.16:3, Sir prol.22, 2Ma.4:23 2Mac 9:21, 4Ma.1:2 * ;]
__1. necessary: At 13:46, 1Co 12:22, 2Co 9:5, Fp 2:25, Tt 3:14, Hb 8:3; comp. -αιότερον, Fp 1:24.
__2. Of persons connected by bonds of nature or friendship, near, intimate (Field, Notes, 118; ΜΜ, VGT, see word): ἀ. φίλοι, At 10:24.†
(AS)

G0317.def:
ἀναγκαστῶς
adv.,
necessarily or by constraint: opposite to ἑκουσίως, 1Pe 5:2 (rare).†
(AS)

G0318.def:
ἀνάγκη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מָצוֹק, צַר ;]
__1. necessity: ἔχειν ἀ-, with inf., to be compelled, Lc 14:18 23:17 (Rec., R, mg.), 1Co 7:37, Ju 3, Hb 7:27; ἐξ ἀ., κατ᾽ ἀ., of necessity, 2Co 9:7, Hb 7:12, Phm 14; ἀ. μοι ἐπίκειται, n. is laid on me, 1Co 9:16; with inf. (= ἀναγκαῖον ἐστι), Mt 18:7, Rm 13:5, Hb 9:16, 23
__2. force, violence, hence pain, distress (Diod., al.; LXX; see M, Th., 41; MM, VGT, see word; cf. θλίψις): Lc 21:23, 1Co 7:26, 1Ts 3:7; pl. (see B1., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), ἐν ἀ., 2Co 6:4 12:10.†
(AS)

G0319.def:
ἀνα-γνωρίζω
[in LXX: Gn 45:1 (יָדַע hith.)* ;]
to recognize: At 7:13 (WH, txt., ἐγνωρίσθη).†
(AS)

G0320.def:
ἀνά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: Ne 8:8 (מִקְרָא), I Et 9:48, Sir prol. 9, 13 * ;]
__1. recognition (Hdt.).
__2. reading (Plat., al.): of the public reading of Scripture (Milligan, NTD, 173, 210 f.): At 13:15, 2Co 3:14, 1Tm 4:13 (Cremer, 158; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0321.def:
ἀν-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi. ;]
to lead or bring up: before είς, with accusative loc., Mt 4:1, Lc 2:22 4:5 (WH om. είς, κ.τ.λ.), At 9:39 16:34; of raising the dead (cl.), ἐκ νεκρῶν, Rm 10:7, Hb 13:20; to produce and set before, τ. λαῷ, At 12:4 (MM, VGT, see word); in sacrificial sense (MM, 1 with), to offer, θυσίαν, At 7:41. Mid., in nautical sense (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.), to put to sea: Lc 8:22, At 13:13 16:11 18:21 20:3, 13 21:1-2 27:2, 4 27:12, 21 28:10-11 (cf.ἐπ-ανάγω).†
(AS)

G0322.def:
ἀνα-δείκνυμι
[in LXX: Hc 3:2 (יָדַע), Dan LXX 1:11 (מָנָה), Dn 1:20 (מָצָא), 1Esdra.6.2, 3Mac.9 * ;]
__1. to lift up and show, show forth, declare (cf. 2Ma.2:8, see MM, VGT, see word): At 1:24.
__2. to consecrate, set apart, (Strab., Plut., Anth.): Lc 10:1.†
(AS)

G0323.def:
ἀνά-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναδείκνυμι), [in LXX: Sir.43:6 * ;]
a sheaving forth, announcement: Lc 1:80.†
(AS)

G0324.def:
ἀνα-δέχομαι
[in LXX: 2Ma.6:19 2Mac 8:36 * ;]
__1. to assume, undertake (in π. frequently as legal term: MM, VGT, see word): ἐπαγγελίας, Hb 11:17.
__2. = cl. ὑποδέχομαι, to receive: of guests, At 28:7.†
(AS)

G0325.def:
ἀνα-δίδωμι
[in LXX: Sir.1:22, 2Ma.13:15 * ;]
__1. to give forth, send up, as of plants (Hdt., al.).
__2. to give up, yield, hand over (MM, VGT, see word): At 23:33.†
(AS)

G0326.def:
ἀνα-ζάω, -ῶ
[in Al.: Gn 45:27 * ;]
to live again, regain life (cf. cl. ἀναβιόω; Cremer, 722; and for other exx., v MM, VGT, see word): metaphorically of moral revival, Lc 15:24 (WH, mg., ἔζησεν); of sin, Rm 7:9.†
(AS)

G0327.def:
ἀνα-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jó 3:4 (דָּרַשׁ), Jó 10:6 (בָּקַשׁ pi.), 2Ma.13:21 * ;]
to look for or seek carefully ("specially of searching for human beings, with an implication of difficulty": MM, VGT, see word): Lc 2:44-45 At 11:25.†
(AS)

G0328.def:
ἀνα-ζώννυμι
[in LXX: Jz 18:16, Pv 31:17 (חָגַר)* ;]
to gird up: figuratively, τ. ὀσφύας τ. διανοίας, 1Pe 1:13.†
(AS)

G0329.def:
ἀνα-ζωπυργέω, -ῶ
(ζωός, πῦρ), [in LXX: 1Ma.13:7 * ;]
to kindle afresh: metaphorically, 2Tm 1:6 (for vernac. exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0330.def:
ἀνα-θάλλω
(θάλλω, to flourish), [in LXX: Sl 28:7 (עָלַז), Eze.17:24 (פָּרַח hi.), Os 8:9, Wis.4:4, Sir.5:1-15 * ;]
to revive: Fp 4:10 (of MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0331.def:
ἀνάθεμα, -τος, τό
(ἀνατίθημι),
Hellenistic for Attic ἀνάθημα (Bl., § 27, 2);
__1. prop. = τὸ ἀνατιθέμένον, that which is laid by to be kept, a votive offering (as ἀνάθημα in 2Ma.2:13, Lc 21:5—where LT read -θεμα, see M, Pr., 46).
__2. [As equiv. in LXX for חֵרֶם,] devoted, a thing devoted to God (see Driver, De., 98 f., and cf. Lv 27:28-29), hence;
__(a) of the sentence pronounced (Dt 13:15), a curse: At 23:14;
__(b) of the object on which the curse is laid, accursed (Dt 7:26): Rm 9:3, 1Co 12:3 16:22, Gl 1:8-9 (see ICC on Ro.; Lft., Ga., ll. with; Cremer, 547; Tr., Syn., § v; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0332.def:
ἀνα-θεματίζω
(ἀνίθεμα), [in LXX chiefly for חָרַם hi. (Nm 21:2, 1Rs 15:3, al.), 1Ma.5:5 ;]
to devote to destruction, declare or invoke ana­thema: absol., Mc 14:71; ἐαντόν, to bind oneself under a curse: At 23:12, 14 23:21 (cf. καταναθεματίζω, and on the occurrence of the word in π., see Deiss., LAE, 92 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0333.def:
ἀνα-θεωρέω, -ῶ
to observe carefully, consider well: At 17:23, Hb 13:7 (Diod., al.).†
(AS)

G0334.def:
ἀνάθημα, -τος, τό
(cf. ἀνάθημα, and see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX often as seel. for ἀνάθεμα (חָרַם), and in Nm 21:3, Jz 1:17 for חׇרְמָה, but prop. in 3Ma.3:17, al. ;]
a gift set up in a temple, a votive offering: Lc 21:5 (LT, -θεμα).†
(AS)

G0335.def:
ἀναιδία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ
(αἰδώς), [in LXX: Sir.25:22 * ;]
shamelessness, importunity: Lc 11:8 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0336.def:
ἀν-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναιρέω), [in LXX: Nm 11:15 (הָרַג), Jz 15:17 (רָמָה), Jdth.15:4, 2Ma.5:13 * ;]
__1. a taking up or away (Thuc.).
__2. a destroying, slaying, murder (Field, Notes, 116; MM, VGT, see word): At 8:1.†
(AS)

G0337.def:
ἀν-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for הָרַג hi., מוּת hi., נָכָה hi., etc. ;]
__1. to take up: mid., At 7:21.
__2. to take away, make an end of, destroy (for late exx. of various senses, see MM, VGT, see word);
__(a) of things (as frequently in cl. of laws, etc.): Hb 10:9;
__(b) of persons, to kill: Mt 2:16, Lc 22:2 23:32, At 2:23 5:33, 36 7:28 9:23-24, 29 10:39 12:2 13:28 16:27 22:20 23:15, 21 23:27 25:3 26:10, 2Ts 2:8, WH, txt., R, txt.†
(AS)

G0338.def:
ἀν-αίτιος, -ον
(αἰτία), [in LXX: Dt 19:10, 13 21:8-9 (נָקִי), Dan LXX TH Sus1:62, always of αἷμα (of. MM, VGT, see word)* ;]
guiltless, innocent: Mt 12:5, 7.†
(AS)

G0339.def:
ἀνα-καθ-ίζω
(see: καθίζω);
__1. trans., to set up.
__2. Intrans., to sit up: Lc 7:15 (WH, mg., ἐκάθισεν), At 9:40 (frequently in medical writings: MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)

G0340.def:
ἀνα-καινίζω
(καινός), [in LXX: 2Cr 15:8, Sl 103:5 104:30, La 5:21 (חָדַשׁ pi., hith)., Sl 39:2 (עָכַר ni.), 1Ma.6:9 * ;]
to renew: Hb 6:6 (Isocr., Plut.).†
(AS)

G0341.def:
ἀνα-καινόω, -ῶ
= ἀνακαινίζω (cf. MM, VGT, see word),
to make new: 2Co 4:16, Cl 3:10 (see Cremer, 323).†
(AS)

G0342.def:
ἀνακαίνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνακαινόω),
renewal: Rm 12:2, Tt 3:5 (Cremer, 324; MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: παλινγενεσία, in NT, new birth, of which ἀ. is the conse­quent renewal or renovation, in which man as well as God takes part (see Tr., Syn., § xviii) (AS)

G0343.def:
ἀνα-καλύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ni., pi. ;]
to unveil: metaphorically of removing hindrance to perception of spiritual things, 2Co 3:14 3:18.†
(AS)

G0344.def:
ἀνα-κάμπτω
[in LXX: 1Cr 19:5, Jr 3:1, al. (שׁוּב), Jr 15:5 (סוּר) ;]
__1. trans., to bend or turn back.
__2. Intrans., to return: Mt 2:12, At 18:21, Hb 11:15; metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), Lc 10:6.†
(AS)

G0345.def:
ἀνά-κειμαι
[in LXX: I Et 4:10, Tob.9:6 א * ;]
__1. in cl., as pass. of ἀνατίθημ, to be laid up, laid: Mc 5:40 Rec.
__2. In late writers (cf. MM, VGT, see word) = κεῖσθαι, κατακεῖσθαι, to recline at table: Mt 26:20; part. ἀνακείμενος, Mt 9:10 22:10-11 26:7, Mc 6:26 14:18 16:14, Lc 22:27, Jo 6:11 12:2 13:23, 28.†
SYN.: ἀνακλίνω, ἀναπίπτω, the latter denoting an act rather than a state and thus in Jo 13:25 differing from ἀνάκειμαι (see. Jo 13:23) by indicating a change of position. (AS)

G0346.def:
ἀνα-κεφαλαιόω, ῶ
(see: κεφαλαιόω) [in Th., Al.: Sl 72:20 * ;]
to sum up, gather up, present as a whole: mid., Rm 13:9, Ef 1:10 (on WH. see Lft., Notes, 321 L; AR, in l; Cremer, 354, 748).†
(AS)

G0347.def:
ἀνα-κλίνω
[in LXX: 3Ma.5:16 * ;]
to lay upon, lean against, hence,
__(a) to lay down: Lc 2:7;
__(b) to make to recline: Mc 6:39, WH, mg., Lc 12:37. Pass., to lie back, recline: Mt 8:11 14:19, Lc 13:29.†
SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀναπίπτω (AS)

G0349.def:
ἀνα-κράζω
[in LXX for קָרָא, etc. ;]
to cry out, shout: Mc 1:23 6:49, Lc 4:33 8:28 23:18.†
(AS)

G0350.def:
ἀνα-κρίνω
[in LXX: 1Rs 20:12 (חָקַר), Dan LXX Su 1:13, LXX, TH Su 1:48, 51 * ;]
to examine, investigate, question (Lft., Notes, 181 f.): At 17:11, 1Co 2:14-15 4:3-4 9:3 10:25 10:27 14:24; in forensic sense (MM, VGT, see word; esp. of examination by torture; see Field, Notes, 120 f.), Lc 23:14, At 4:9 12:19 24:8 28:18.†
SYN.: see: ἐξετάζω (AS)

G0351.def:
ἀνά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: 3Ma.7:5 * ;]
an examination: spec. of legal preliminary investigation, At 25:26 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0352.def:
άνα-κύπτω
[in LXX: Jó 10:15 (נָשָׂא רֹאשׁ), Dan LXX, Su 1:35 * ;]
to lift oneself up;
__(a) bodily; Lc 13:11, Jo 8:7, 10;
__(b) mentally, to be elated: Lc 21:28 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0353.def:
ἀνα-λαμβάνω
[in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא, also for לָקַח, etc. ;]
__1. to take up, raise: Mc 16:19, At 1:2, 11 1:22 10:16, 1Tm 3:16.
__2. to take up, take to oneself: At 7:43 20:13-14 23:31, Ef 6:13, 16, 2Tm 4:11 (for late exx., v MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0354.def:
ἀνά-λημψις, -εως, ἡ
(κοινή form of ἀνάληψις; see Th., Gr., 108 f.),
a taking up: Lc 9:51 (MM, VGT, see word).†
ἀνά-ληψις, -εως, ἡ, Rec. for ἀνάλημψις, which see
(AS)

G0355.def:
ἀν-αλίσκω
(on the etymology, see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל also for כָּלָה, etc. ;]
__1. to expend.
__2. to consume, destroy: Lc 9:54, Gl 5:15, 2Ts 2:8, Rec. WH, mg.†
(AS)

G0356.def:
ἀναλογία, -ας, ἡ
(λόγος), [in Al.: Lv 27:1-34"18 * ;]
proportion (MM, VGT, see word): Rm 12:6 (cf. Cremer, 397).†
(AS)

G0357.def:
ἀνα-λογίζομαι
[in LXX: Wis.17:13 א, 2Ma.12:43 A, 3Ma.7:7 * ;]
to consider: Hb 12:3 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0359.def:
ἀνά-λυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναλύω),
a loosing, e.g. of a vessel from its moorings, hence, departure: from life, 2Tm 4:6.†
(AS)

G0360.def:
ἀνα-λύω
[in LXX: I Et 3:3, Tob.2:9, Jdth.13:1, Sir.3:15, Wis.3:1-19 2:1-24,3 Mac.10 * ;]
__1. to unloose.
__2. to unloose for departure, depart (MM, VGT, see word): from life, Fp 1:23
__3. to return, Lc 12:36.†
(AS)

G0361.def:
ἀναμάρτητος, -ον
(ἁμαρτεῖν), [in LXX: Dt 29:19 (18) 2Ma.8:4 2Mac 12:42 * ;]
__1. without missing, unerring (Xen.).
__2. In moral sense, faultless (Plat.), without sin: Jo 8:7 (see Cremer, 102, 634; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0362.def:
ἀνα-μένω
[in LXX for קָוָה pi. ;]
to await "one whose coming is expected, perhaps with the added idea of patience and confidence" with accusative, 1Ts 1:10 (see M, Th., in l; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0363.def:
ἀνα-μιμνήσκω
[in LXX for זָכַר hi. ;]
to remind, call to one's remembrance: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 4:17; with inf., 2Tm 1:6. Pass., to remember, call to mind: Mc 11:21 14:72, 2Co 7:15, Hb 10:32.†
(AS)

G0364.def:
ἀνάμνησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναμιμνήσκω), [in LXX: Sl 38:1-22 70:1-5 title. (זָכַר hi.), Lv 24:7 (אַזְכָּרָה), Nm 10:10 (זִכְרוֹן), Wis.16:6 * ;]
remembrance: εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀ., Lc 22:19 (WH om.), 1Co 11:24-25; ἀ. ἁμαρτιῶν, Hb 10:3 (see Abbott, Essays, 122 ff.; DCG, ii, 74a).†
SYN.: ὑπόμνησις (see Tr., Syn., § cvii). (AS)

G0365.def:
ἀνα-νεόω, -ῶ
(νέος), [in LXX: Jó 33:24, Et 3:13, 1; Ed 3:1-13, 4Ma.8:1-29 * ;]
to renew: pass., Ef 4:23 (see Cremer, 428; MM, VGT, see word)†
(AS)

G0367G.def:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה),
Ananias;
__1. of Jerusalem: At 5:1, 3 5:5.
__2. Of Damascus: At 9:10-13, 17 22:12.
__3. High Priest: At 23:2 24:1.†
(AS)

G0367H.def:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה),
Ananias;
__1. of Jerusalem: At 5:1, 3 5:5.
__2. Of Damascus: At 9:10-13, 17 22:12.
__3. High Priest: At 23:2 24:1.†
(AS)

G0367I.def:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה),
Ananias;
__1. of Jerusalem: At 5:1, 3 5:5.
__2. Of Damascus: At 9:10-13, 17 22:12.
__3. High Priest: At 23:2 24:1.†
(AS)

G0368.def:
ἀν-αντί-ρητος
(Τ, -ρρητος, -ον (ῥητός, spoken), [in Sm.: Jó 11:2 33:13 * ;]
not to be contradicted, undeniable: At 19:36 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0370.def:
ἀν-άξιος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἄξιος), [in LXX: Jr 15:19 א2 (זָלַל), Et 8:13, Sir.25:8 * ;]
unworthy: with genitive, 1Co 6:2 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0371.def:
ἀναξίως
(see supr.), adv., [in LXX: 2Ma.14:42 * ;]
in an unworthy manner: 1Co 11:27.†
(AS)

G0372.def:
ἀνά-παυσις, -εως, ή
(ἀνάπαύω) [in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ and its derivatives, שַׁבָּת and its cognates (Ex, Le) ;]
cessation, rest, refreshment: Mt 11:26 12:43, Lc 11:24, Ap 4:8 14:11.†
SYN.: ἄνεσις (lit, the relaxation of the strings of a lyre), prop. signifies the rest or ease which comes from the relaxation of unfavour­able conditions, as, e.g. affliction: ἀνάπ., the rest which comes from the temporary cessation of labour (see Tr., Stn., § xl; Cremer, 827; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0373.def:
ἀνα-παύω,
[in LXX for fourteen different words, chiefly נוּחַ, also רָבַץ, שָׁאַן, etc. ;]
to give intermission from labour, to give rest, refresh: Mt 11:28, 1Co 16:18, Phm 20; pass., Phm 7, 2Co 7:13. Mid., to take rest, enjoy rest: Mt 26:45, Mc 6:31 14:41, Lc 12:19, Ap 6:11 14:13; as in Heb. ofIs 11:2 (עַל נוּחַ), τὸ πνεῦμα ἐφ᾽ ὑᾶμς ἀ., 1Pe 4:14. (In π. this word is used as a technical agricultural term; see MM, VGT, see word; and cf. Le 2634 f.; Cremer, 826.)†
(AS)

G0374.def:
ἀνα-πείθω
[in LXX: Jr 29:8 (נָשָׁא hi.), 1Ma.1:11 * ;]
to per­suade, incite: At 18:13 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0375.def:
ἀνα-πέμπω
__1. to send up,
__(a) to a higher place (Æsch., Plat., al.);
__(b) to a higher authority (Deiss., BS, 229; MM, VGT, see word; cf. also Field, Notes, 140): Lc 23:7, 15, At 25:21.
__2. to send back (Pind.): Lc 23:11, Phm 11.†
(AS)

G0376.def:
ἀνά-πηρος (WH, -ειρος; see Field, Notes, 67), -ον (πηρός, maimed)
[in LXX: Tob.14:2 א, 2Ma.8:24 * ;]
maimed, crippled: Lc 14:13, 21.†
(AS)

G0377.def:
ἀνα-πίπτω
[in LXX: Gn 49:9 (כָּרַע) Tob.2:1 7:8, Jdth.12:10, Sir.25:18 32:2, Da TH Sus 1:37 * ;]
__1. (cl.) to fall back.
__2. In late writers = ἀνα-κλίνομαι, to recline for a repast (MM, VGT, see word): at table, Lc 11:37 14:10 17:7 22:14, Jo 13:12 21:20; on the ground, Mt 15:35 Mc 6:40 8:6 Jo 6:10; to lean back, Jo 13:25 (T, ἐπιπεσών; see: ἀνάκειμαι, ad fin.).†
SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀνακλίνομαι (AS)

G0378.def:
ἀνα-πληρόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, Lv 12:6, al.; also שָׁלַם (Gn 15:16, 3Ki.7:51, Is 60:20), etc. ;]
__1. to fill up, make full (in π. of com­pleting contracts and making up rent; cf. MM, VGT, see word): τόπον, take one's place (cf. Heb. מָקוֹם שָׁלַם), 1Co 14:16; άμαρτίας, complete the number, 1Ts 2:16; τ. νόμον, observe perfectly, Gl 6:2; pass., προφητεία, fulfilled, Mt 13:14.
__2. to supply: τό ὑστέρημα, 1Co 16:17, Fp 2:30 (Cremer, 838).†
(AS)

G0379.def:
ἀναπολόγητος, -ον
(ἀπολογεόμαι),
without excuse, inexcusable (in Polyb., al., as a forensic term; see Lft., Notes, 252): Rm 1:20 2:1.†
(AS)

G0380.def:
ἀνα-πτύσσω
[in LXX for פָּרַשׂ,etc. ;]
to unroll: τ. βιβλίον, Lc 4:17 (WH, R, ἀνοίξας).†
(AS)

G0381.def:
ἀν-άπτω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא ;]
to kindle: Lc 12:49, Tg 3:5 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0383.def:
ἀνα-σείω
[in Aq.: 1Rs 26:19, Jó 2:3; Aq., Sm.: Is 36:18 * ;]
__1. to shake out, shake back, move to and fro (Thuc., a1.).
__2. In late writers (Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word), to stir up; metaphorically, to excite: τ. ὄχλον, Mc 15:11; τ. λαόν, Lc 23:5.†
(AS)

G0384.def:
ἀνα-σκευάζω
(σκεῦος, a vessel),
prop, to pack up baggage, hence, to dismantle, ravage, destroy; metaphorically, to unsettle, subvert (MM, VGT, see word): ψυχάς, At 15:24.†
(AS)

G0385.def:
ἀνα-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for לָקַח, עָלָה hi. ;]
to draw up: Lc 14:5, At 11:10 (in π. of pulling up barley; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0386.def:
ἀνά-στασις, -εως, ή
(ἀνίστημι), [in LXX: Sf 3:8 (קוּם), La 3:63 (קִימָה), קִימָה), Sl 66:1-20 title., Dan LXX 11:20, 2Ma.7:14 2Mac 12:43 * ;]
__1. a raising up, awakening, rising (in Inscr. of the erection of a monument, see MM, VGT, see word): Lc 2:34.
__2. a rising from the dead (see DCG, ii, 605b);
__(a) of Christ: At 1:22 2:31 4:33 Rm 6:5, Fp 3:10, 1Pe 3:21; ἐξ ἀ. νεκρῶν, Rm 1:4 (ICC, in l); ἐκ νεκρῶν, 1Pe 1:3;
__(b) of persons in OT hist. (e.g. 3Ki.17:17 ff.): Hb 11:35;
__(with) of the general resurrection: Mt 22:23, 28 22:30 Mc 12:18, 23 Lc 20:27, 33 20:36, Jo 11:24, At 17:18 23:8 24:15, 2Tm 2:18; ἀ. ἐκ νεκρῶν, Lc 20:35, At 4:2; τῶν νεκρῶν, Mt 22:31, At 17:32 23:6 24:21 26:23, 1Co 15:12-13 15:21 15:42, Hb 6:2; ἀ. ζωῆς, resurrection to life (cf. 2Ma.7:14, ἀ. εἰς ζωήν) and ἀ. τ. κρίσεως, τ. to judgment, Jo 5:29; ἀ. τ. δικαίων, Lc 14:14; κρείττων ἀ., Hb 11:35; on ἡ ἀ. ἡ πρώτη, Ap 20:5-8, see Swete, in l, Weste. on Jo 5:1-47, but see also Thayer, see word; by meton. of Christ as Author of ἀ., Jo 11:25 (see DB, iv, 231; Cremer, 307).†
(AS)

G0387.def:
ἀνα-στατόω, ῶ
(ἀνάστατος, driven from home; ἀνίστημι), [in LXX: Dn 7:23 (דּוּשׁ;* also in Aq., and in π. (see Deiss., LAE, 80 f.; MM, VGT, see word),]
to stir up, excite, unsettle: with accusative;
__(a) to tumult and sedition: At 17:6 21:38;
__(b) by false teaching: Gl 5:12 (see Milligan, NTD, 73 f.).†
(AS)

G0388.def:
ἀνα-σταυρόω
__1. to impale (Hdt.).
__2. to raise on a cross, crucify (Polyb., al.).
__3. to crucify again: Hb 6:6 (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G0389.def:
ἀνα-στενάζω
[in LXX: La 1:4 (אָנַח ni.), Sir.25:17), Da TH Sus 1:22, 2Ma.6:30 * ;]
to sigh deeply: Mc 8:12.†
(AS)

G0390.def:
ἀνα-στρέφω
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;]
__1. to overturn: Jo 2:15.
__2. to turn back, return: At 5:22 15:16.
__3. to turn hither and thither; pass., to turn oneself about, sojourn, dwell: Mt 17:22 Rec.; metaphorically (like Heb. הָלַךְ, in κοινή writers and in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 315; BS, 88, 194; MM, VGT, see word), to conduct oneself, behave, live: 2Co 1:12, Ef 2:3, 1Tm 3:15, Hb 10:33 13:18, 1Pe 1:17, 2Pe 2:18.
† SYN.: περιπατέω (Hellenistic), πολιτεύω (AS)

G0391.def:
ἀνα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀναστρέφομαι) [in LXX: Tob.4:14, 2Ma.5:8 2Mac 6:23 * ;]
__1. a turning down or back, a wheeling about (Soph., Thuc., al.).
__2. In late writers (Polyb., al.; see: ἀναστρέφω, and cf. Hort on Tg 3:13; MM, VGT, see word), manner of life, behaviour, conduct: Gl 1:13, Ef 4:22, 1Tm 4:12, Hb 13:7, Tg 3:13, 1Pe 1:15 1:18 2:12 3:1-2 3:16, 2Pe 2:7 3:11.†
(AS)

G0392.def:
ἀνα-τάσσομαι
[in LXX only as seel. (Ald.) in Ec 2:20 ;]
to arrange in order, bring together from memory (Blass., Phil. Gosp., 14 ff.; MM, VGT, see word): Lc 1:1.†
(AS)

G0393.def:
ἀνα-τέλλω
[in LXX for צָמַח, פָּרַח, זָרַח, etc. ;]
__1. trans., to cause to rise: Mt 5:45.
__2. Intrans., to rise: φῶς, Mt 4:16 (= Is 9:1); ὁ ἥλιος, Mt 13:6, Mc 4:6 16:2, Tg 1:11; νεφέλη, Lc 12:54; φωσφόρος, 2Pe 1:19; ὁ Κύριος, prob. with ref. to metaphorically of sun or star, Hb 7:14 (cf. ἐξ-ανατέλλω).†
(AS)

G0394.def:
ἀνα-τίθημι
[in LXX chiefly for חָרַם (Cremer, 546) ;]
to lay upon, set up, etc. Mid. -εμαι, in late writers (Plut., al.; see also MM, VGT, see word), to set forth, declare: At 25:14, Gl 2:2.†
(AS)

G0395.def:
ἀνατολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀνατέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְרָח קָדִים ;]
__1. a rising: of light, Lc 1:78.
__2. the sun-rising, the east (MM, VGT, see word): Mt 2:2, 9, Ap 21:13; ἀ. ἡλίου, Ap 7:2 16:12 (WΗ, p1.); pl., Mt 2:1 8:11 24:27, Lc 13:29.†
(AS)

G0396.def:
ἀνα-τρέπω
[in LXX for דָּחָה, הָדַף, etc. ;]
to overturn, destroy: Jo 2:15 WH, txt.; metaphorically, to subvert (MM, VGT, see word): 2Tm 2:18, Tt 1:11.†
(AS)

G0397.def:
ἀνα-τρέφω
[in LXX: Wis.7:4 B, 4Ma.10:2 4Mac 11:15 א* ;]
to nurse up, nourish, educate, bring up: Lc 4:16, WΗ, mg., At 7:20-21 22:3.†
(AS)

G0398.def:
ἀνα-φαίνομαι
[in LXX for צָדַק hi., גָּלַשׁ ;]
to bring to light, make to appear: ἀναφάναντες τ. Κύπρον, i.e. having sighted C.: At 21:3 WH; pass., to appear, be made manifest: Lc 19:11
(AS)

G0399.def:
ἀνα-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for קָטַר hi., etc. ;]
__1. to carry or lead up: with accusative of person(s), Mt 17:1, Mc 9:2; pass., Lc 24:51 (WH, rejects, R, mg. omits); ἀ. τ. ἁμαρτίας ἐπί τ. ξύλον (see Deiss., 135, 88 f.; ICC, in l; MM, VGT, see word): 1Pe 2:24.
__2. In LXX and NT, to bring to the altar, to offer (see Hort on 1Pe, l.with): θυσίας, etc., Hb 7:27 13:15, 1Pe 2:5; ἐπί τ. θυσιαστήριον, Tg 2:21 (see Mayor, in l).
__3. to bear, sustain (cf. Nm 14:33, Is 53:12): Hb 9:28.†
(AS)
